messages.content: What color was the sunlight on the Wizard’s face as he said “Nonsense” to Dorothy?
Violet.
What did Zeb and the Wizard take off the hinges when the Gargoyles drew back?
The wooden doors.
What did they do with the doors?
They tossed them onto the flames.
How old was the dragonettes’ mother according to the young dragonette?
About two thousand years old.
Why was her age only an estimate?
She lost track of her age and skipped several hundred years.
What color was the Cowardly Lion’s mane when Jim saw him beside the Tiger?
Tawny.
What blocked the passage above the dragonettes’ cavern?
A huge rock.
How was it moving?
It was turning around as if on a pivot.
Who was the last one to cross when the path appeared again?
Jim the cab-horse.
How many times did the Woggle-Bug demand that the death penalty be inflicted on Eureka?
Nine times.
What color were the velvet uniforms of the band leading the Oz parade?
Emerald green.
What was that band called?
The Imperial Cornet Band of Oz.
